newsitem.title: UK: BFI down 14 as Panamaxes weaken further.
newsitem.headline: BFI down 14 as Panamaxes weaken further.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down 14 points on Friday to 1,467 and brokers said the week has ended quietly with freight rates continuing to fall in many trades.
Hanjin were reported to have fixed NSAC tonnage for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for April 13/23 at a weaker $24.85 no combo.
Hall were rumoured to have fixed Sumava 71,000 dwt delivery prompt US Gulf trip Far East also at a weaker level of $14,500 daily plus about $275,000 bonus.
Caper rates were also generally easier and the Handy market remained quiet.
BIFFEX was five points lower to five points higher and turnover at 1300 BST was 115 lots.
